status: pilot budget frozen after CPU train/resume and development evaluation smoke; final seeds unused
reward: terminal team win +1 / loss -1 only; gamma=1; no intermediate or entropy bonus
truncation: no fabricated draw or terminal reward; exclude incomplete episode updates and report rate; substantial truncation requires fixing the pilot before interpreting improvement

evaluation.primarySelection: sampled policy, per-game deterministic RNG streams
modes: one model seat with two v1.5 teammates vs v1.5, paired with all-v1.5 control
evaluation.uncertainty: bootstrap whole seed clusters across lineups/teams/starts, report each training seed separately
evaluation.modelSelection: freeze budget after throughput smoke; use each run's last checkpoint, no final-set checkpoint selection
evaluation.knownDiagnostics: ordinary-water vs waterSeal opportunity cost and only-waterSeal survival, with reversed hand order; not independent generalization evidence
evaluation.limits: twelve final seed clusters are a small pilot; no claim of human strength or universal superiority

pilotBudget.checkpointSelection: last completed fixed-budget checkpoint; incomplete timeout is reported, not silently accepted as full budget
